note: Shop pitch: a fledgling's blade, fine if you have no money.
Traded for the Crest of Glory in Tumba. Needed for the Tumba boss per sage Grodea.
妖 = uncanny, bewitching. Only weapon that can slay the Archfiend (Pureza youth).
X1 uses the 楯 form of 'shield'.
JP pitch: once used by 'some sage or other'; DOS says 'a well-known hero'.
JP: forged of ミスリル (mithril), a magic metal; DOS changed the metal to 'Magane'.
Light as a feather, hard as diamond. DOS renamed the material.
Title: 投剣の魔法 'spell of the thrown sword' (zukan magic page writes 刀剣; rip site and DOS 'Throwing Swords' support 投剣). Taught by Buena in Satono.
Title: 矢の魔法 'spell of arrows'. Taught by Robust in Bosque.
Title: 火の魔法 'spell of fire'. Taught by Baidal in Helada.
Title: 火炎の魔法 'spell of flame'. Taught by Grodea in Tumba.
Title: 落石の魔法 'spell of falling rocks'. Taught by Jufe in Dorado. Kept DOS spelling.
Title: 水の魔法 'spell of water'. Taught by Ayuda in Llama.
Title: 稲妻の魔法 'spell of lightning'. Taught by Maest in Pureza.
Sage formula: 汝に＿を教えてしんぜよう.
Keep out Gelroid fluid; safe on spikes and fire (Tumba woman).
Let the wearer climb any slope. Hidden in Tesoro.
Ruzeria is a tree of the Zeliard forest with hard, non-slip bark; lets you walk on ice.
Heat-proof. JP price 5000 almas; DOS 2500. Name matches the cavern アブソル洞.
Brewed from yunkel fruit and ripode leaf; cheap restorative.
Fruits once in ten years; heals any wound.
Restores one spell. 'Recobrar' (Sp. to recover) is our reading of the katakana, not attested.
Restores all spells; dragon scale and philosopher's stone, distilled 100 days.
Orbits the user, reacting to Kirlian aura (DOS drops 'Kirlian').
Alchemical liquid metal (mercury and iron) that restores a battered shield. Sp. acero = steel.
X1 label サブルのリング; PC-88 sources write ザブルリング (zukan) or サブルリング (rip site). Boosts sword power.
Returns you to the last sage you heard. DOS swapped Spanish 'memoria' for Japanese 'kioku' (memory).
X1 label reads only ルフの紋章 (first character likely lost in the rip); PC-88 dialogue says エルフの紋章. Given as thanks in Llama.
Prize of the old temple tourney in Bosque; hidden in the thickest tree.

dos_en: Lion Head's Key / lion's head Key
note: Pureza dialogue: 獅子の頭の形をした鍵 'a key shaped like a lion's head'. Rip site writes 獅子の鍵.
Manual only: the castle there was the only land spared by the sand.
Sp. muralla = rampart. 1987-11 advert HUD shows 'SCENE ムララの町'.
Ripper's map caption for Esco mislabels it プレザの町.
Sp. tomb; once a quiet graveyard.
Sp. golden; once a merchant town.
Sp. purity. Ripper's caption for Pureza mislabels it ツンバの町.
洞 = cave; rendered 'Cavern'. 1987-11 advert HUD: 'SCENE マリシア洞'.
Sp. treasure. Built from Dorado's gold.
Katakana reads 'Arushio'; ripper wrote ARRUGIO; DOS Arrugia. Kept DOS.
Katakana reads 'Karentaru' (cf. Sp. calentar, to heat); DOS Caliente.
Rip-site name for world 1; zukan uses 洞窟界. No soundtrack title.
Soundtrack title; rip site 樹木の世界.
Final world; rip site calls it 魔王の世界.

literal: main house of the quiet forest
en: The Lodge in the Quiet Wood
note: X1 checked at 8x: 静かな. PC-88 sources write 静かの森の母屋.
Title bar changes per town sage.

reading: Mahō no Dōgu to Kusuri no Mise
literal: shop of magic tools and medicines

ja: デューク・ガーランド
note: Hero. 'Duke' is a given name, not a title.

ja: フェリーサ・ラ・フェリシカ
聖地ゼリアードの精霊
literal: spirit of the holy land Zeliard
dos_en: the Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard

note: Never named in Japanese; 'Jashiin' is a DOS invention. He calls himself both 俺 and わし.
Son of a Muralla old man; found alive in Llama.
Shoemaker who made the Spirit's shoes; slain by the Archfiend.
Giant bird boss. Rip site writes POLO.
Also the name of Dorado's vanished peace statue.
The deathless beast; the Archfiend's last minion.
Glowing blue microbial ooze that drains life (Tumba).
HUD labels are English in the original (SELECT-MAGIC, WEAR, USE, INVENTORY, LIFE, PLACE, GOLD, ALMAS, ENEMY). Pre-release advert shows SCENE instead of PLACE.
CD title prefixes 'オープニング ～'.
CD: 'プロローグ ～ 旅立ち'.
CD writes 閉ざされた街.
CD: 'エピローグ ～ 新たなる冒険へ'.

ja: 今より二千年の昔 / 人の知らぬ、異空の彼方より / 魔王、現れたり
reading: ima yori nisen-nen no mukashi / hito no shiranu, ikū no kanata yori / maō, arawaretari
literal: Two thousand years before now / from beyond an alien sky unknown to men / a demon king appeared
en: Two thousand years ago, from beyond a sky no mortal knew, the Archfiend came.
dos_en: Two thousand years, from the dark reaches of another galaxy, a demon with not a shred of compassion for humankind, descended upon earth.
note: Title scroll, archaic register (～たり, ～けり). Stanza 1 of 5.

ja: 悪鬼魔獣を従え / 地上の緑を汚し / 世界の王と成る
reading: akki majū o shitagae / chijō no midori o kegashi / sekai no ō to naru
literal: leading devils and demon-beasts / defiling the green of the land / he became king of the world
en: With fiends and monsters at his heel he fouled the green earth, and made himself lord of the world.
dos_en: He defiled the land, sending vile creatures to live in it, and thus became ruler of the world.

ja: フェリシカの王 / 魔王を倒さんと / 聖地ゼリアードの精霊に祈らん
reading: Ferishika no ō / maō o taosan to / seichi Zeriādo no seirei ni inoran
literal: the king of Felishika / meaning to defeat the demon king / prayed to the spirit of the holy land Zeliard
en: The King of Felishika, sworn to cast him down, prayed to the Spirit of holy Zeliard.
dos_en: The King of Felishika, appalled by what had happened, prayed to the Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard for help in defeating this monster.

ja: フェリシカの王 / 精霊より借りたる / 聖なるクリスタル / エスメサンテの涙を使いけり
reading: Ferishika no ō / seirei yori karitaru / seinaru kurisutaru / Esumesante no namida o tsukaikeri
literal: the king of Felishika / used the holy crystals borrowed from the spirit / the Tears of Esmesante
en: And the King wielded the holy crystals lent him by the Spirit: the Tears of Esmesanti.
dos_en: With the help of the holy crystals called Tears of Esmesanti, the King managed to wrest power from the fiend...
note: JP エスメサンテ; DOS spelling 'Esmesanti' kept for the game.

ja: 魔王の力、失せ / 地底に封ぜられり / 再び地上に平和は訪れたり
reading: maō no chikara, use / chitei ni hōzerareri / futatabi chijō ni heiwa wa otozuretari
literal: the demon king's power vanished / he was sealed beneath the earth / peace came again to the land
en: The Archfiend's power failed, and he was sealed in the depths. Peace returned to the world.
dos_en: ...and seal him deep within the bowels of the earth. And once again, the light of peace came to shine upon the earth.

ja: エスメサンテの書 第六章 －暗黒の日－ より
reading: Esumesante no sho dai-roku-shō — ankoku no hi — yori
literal: from the Book of Esmesante, chapter six, 'The Day of Darkness'
en: — The Book of Esmesanti, Chapter Six: "The Day of Darkness"
dos_en: However, it is written in the Sixth Book of Esmesanti: The Age of Darkness.

ja: 我二千年の眠りより蘇り、再びこの世に君臨せん
reading: ware nisen-nen no nemuri yori yomigaeri, futatabi kono yo ni kunrin sen
literal: I rise from a sleep of two thousand years and shall again reign over this world
en: From two thousand years of slumber I rise, and once more I shall rule this world!
dos_en: Beware, for I shall wake from my sleep of 2,000 years and once again reign over the world.
note: Voiced (speech synthesis) on PC-88. Also quoted in the manual.

ja: 暗く重い雲は、国中を覆っていた。…
reading: kuraku omoi kumo wa, kunijū o ōtte ita…
literal: dark heavy clouds covered the whole land; rain fell as if lamenting; a girl watched it
en: Dark, heavy clouds hung over the kingdom, and the rain fell as though in mourning. A young girl stood watching it.
dos_en: Dark clouds filled the sky... Day after day, rain poured from the heavens as if in lament.
note: Excerpt; full line at source. Zukan typo 思い corrected to 重い.

ja: フェリーサ・ラ・フェリシカ姫、フェリシカ国王の一人娘である。
reading: Ferīsa ra Ferishika-hime, Ferishika kokuō no hitorimusume de aru.
literal: Princess Felisa la Felishika, only daughter of the King of Felishika; loved for a sunny smile and a voice like a bell
en: She was Princess Felisa la Felishika, the King's only daughter, beloved by all for her sunlit smile and her voice like a silver bell.
dos_en: The girl was Princess Felicia la Felishika... Her smiles were like sunshine, her voice as beautiful as that of an angel.
note: First sentence quoted; second sentence rendered in en.

ja: フェリーサ姫がバルコニーから見下ろす庭には…
reading: Ferīsa-hime ga barukonī kara miorosu niwa ni wa…
literal: in the garden below the balcony, flowers glistened wet with rain
en: In the garden beneath her balcony, the flowers glistened with rain.

ja: 突然、色とりどりの花は灰色に変わっていき…
reading: totsuzen, irotoridori no hana wa haiiro ni kawatte iki…
literal: suddenly the flowers turned grey, the rain turned to dry sand; trees broke, rivers and lakes were buried; the green land became desert
en: All at once the bright flowers faded to grey and the rain grew heavy. What had been gentle rain became dry sand, burying the earth. Trees and flowers snapped beneath its weight; rivers and lakes vanished. The green kingdom was becoming a desert.
dos_en: Just as the princess spoke these words, the raindrops turned to grains of sand... This ever-green land was turning to desert before her very eyes.
note: Excerpt; zukan typo 皮 corrected to 川.

ja: 魔王の声は、国中に響き渡った。
reading: maō no koe wa, kunijū ni hibikiwatatta.
literal: the demon king's voice rang throughout the land
en: The Archfiend's voice echoed across the kingdom.
dos_en: As the words of the demon resounded over the land...

ja: フェリーサ姫は魔王の呪いによって石にされ…
reading: Ferīsa-hime wa maō no noroi ni yotte ishi ni sare…
literal: Felisa was turned to stone by the curse; 108 days of sand made the land a desert; all hope gone; the people could only weep
en: The Archfiend's curse turned Princess Felisa to stone, and for a hundred and eight days the sand fell until the kingdom was a wasteland. All hope was lost; only ruin remained, and the people could do nothing but weep for their princess.
dos_en: Princess Felicia was turned to stone. The rain of sand continued for 108 days... The people of the kingdom wept...

ja: しかし人々の流す涙は、もう一つの力を呼び覚ました。
reading: shikashi hitobito no nagasu namida wa, mō hitotsu no chikara o yobisamashita.
literal: but the tears the people shed awakened another power
en: But the tears of the people awoke another power.
dos_en: But the tears of the King and his people soon awakened another power.
note: Next sentence (not quoted): the Spirit hears their grief and appears before the King.

ja: そう語ると精霊は、ゆらめくように消えていった。
reading: sō kataru to seirei wa, yurameku yō ni kiete itta.
literal: having spoken so, the spirit faded away shimmering
en: With these words the Spirit wavered like a flame and was gone. The King doubted his own reason, thinking it a phantom born of grief. But on the next day, the dream came true.
dos_en: Having spoken these words, the Spirit disappeared... But the next day, a stranger appeared in the kingdom...
note: First sentence quoted; the rest rendered.

ja: 精霊の光に導かれ、デューク・ガーランドはフェリシカの国に到着した。
reading: seirei no hikari ni michibikare, Dyūku Gārando wa Ferishika no kuni ni tōchaku shita.
literal: guided by the spirit's light, Duke Garland arrived in Felishika; he was shown to the king
en: Led by the Spirit's light, Duke Garland came to Felishika, and was brought before the King.
dos_en: Guided by the light of the Spirit, brave Duke Garland had journeyed many days to the land of Zeliard.

ja: フェリシカ王とデュークの前に突然、魔王の姿が現れた。
reading: Ferishika-ō to Dyūku no mae ni totsuzen, maō no sugata ga arawareta.
literal: suddenly the demon king's form appeared before the king and Duke
en: Suddenly the Archfiend stood before the King and Duke.
dos_en: Suddenly, the room grew cold. A black mist swirled around them, then took on a hideous shape.

ja: 魔王の姿は笑い声だけを残し、消えていった。
reading: maō no sugata wa waraigoe dake o nokoshi, kiete itta.
literal: the demon king's form vanished, leaving only laughter
en: The Archfiend vanished, leaving only his laughter behind.
dos_en: With that, Jashiin disappeared leaving echoes of earsplitting laughter.

ja: ついに運命の扉は、開かれた。
reading: tsui ni unmei no tobira wa, hirakareta.
literal: at last the door of fate was opened; the labyrinth is deep, the road long; can Duke defeat the demon king?
en: At last the door of destiny stood open. The Archfiend's labyrinth runs deep, and the road to him is long. Can Duke Garland truly bring him down?
dos_en: At last, the door of destiny was opened. The labyrinths are deep, and the way is long. Will Duke Garland be successful in dethroning the Emperor of Chaos?
What a dreadful storm! Will it never end?

ja: これはいったい、何者の仕業？
reading: kore wa ittai, nanimono no shiwaza?
en: Who could do such a thing?
dos_en: How can this be? What evil power could cause such a terrible thing to happen?

ja: 我を封じ込めし者の末裔よ、二千年の怨みを込めた呪いを思い知るがいい。
reading: ware o fūjikomeshi mono no matsuei yo, nisen-nen no urami o kometa noroi o omoishiru ga ii.
literal: descendant of those who sealed me, know the curse filled with two thousand years of hatred
en: Heir of those who sealed me away! Feel a curse steeped in two thousand years of hatred!
dos_en: I am Jashiin, the Emperor of Chaos. The descendants of those who imprisoned me under the earth shall know that my wrath has smoldered for two thousand years!
note: Archfiend. Blog typo 思い知る知る resolved; zukan まつえい = 末裔.

ja: 我が力が満ちし時、神々の沈む夜にいけにえとしてもらいにくるぞ。
reading: waga chikara ga michishi toki, kamigami no shizumu yoru ni ikenie to shite morai ni kuru zo.
literal: when my power is full, on the night the gods sink, I will come to take (her) as a sacrifice
en: When my power is whole, on the Night the Gods Sink, I shall return to claim her as my sacrifice!
dos_en: Beautiful Princess Felicia, you will make a lovely and terrifying symbol of my awakening...
note: 'The night the gods sink' (神の沈む夜) = the new moon two months on, per the manual and advert.

ja: おお、我が愛しい娘よ。石となっては私の声も届くまい。…
reading: ō, waga itoshii musume yo. ishi to natte wa watashi no koe mo todokumai…
literal: oh my beloved daughter; turned to stone, my voice cannot reach you; my kingdom can only perish; until then I will stay by your side
en: O my beloved daughter... in stone, you cannot hear my voice. My kingdom is doomed. Until the end comes, let me at least stay here beside you.
dos_en: Oh, my beloved Felicia! I fear the Age of Darkness is upon us. I am powerless to stop it ... and powerless to help you.

ja: 私は聖地ゼリアードを守る精霊。…
reading: watashi wa seichi Zeriādo o mamoru seirei…
literal: I am the spirit guarding Zeliard; ... only a new barrier made with the Tears of Esmesante can seal him; no one of this land can win back the crystals; one person alone can; he is already here; wait for him and tell him everything
en: I am the Spirit who guards the holy land of Zeliard. Now that the Archfiend has risen, a dark age will fall upon the world once more. King of Felishika, only by raising the barrier anew with the Tears of Esmesanti can his power be bound. None of your people can slay his beasts and win back the crystals. Yet there is one in all the world with the strength to stand against him, and that one has already come to your land. Only he can reclaim the nine crystals from the Archfiend's minions and save your kingdom. Wait for him, and tell him all. He will surely fight for you and for this land.
dos_en: I am the Guardian Spirit of the Holy Land of Zeliard... You must await the arrival of this brave and noble knight, and tell him everything.
note: Spirit. Long speech; excerpt only, full text at source.

ja: なんという不思議な国だ、この城以外はすべて砂漠とは。…
reading: nan to iu fushigi na kuni da, kono shiro igai wa subete sabaku to wa…
literal: what a strange country, all desert except this castle; is there really something I must do here?
en: What a strange land, all desert save this castle. Is there truly some task for me here?
dos_en: What a desolate place! Why has the Spirit led me here?

ja: デューク・ガーランドよ、そなたが精霊の申していた運命の者。…
reading: Dyūku Gārando yo, sonata ga seirei no mōshite ita unmei no mono…
literal: Duke Garland, you are the one of destiny the spirit spoke of; please save this land and my stone-cursed daughter
en: Duke Garland, you are the chosen one the Spirit foretold. I beg you, save this kingdom and my daughter from her curse of stone.
dos_en: Duke Garland! You must be the man of destiny of whom the Spirit spoke...

ja: フェリシカ王殿、私は精霊の導きでここに来ました。…
reading: Ferishika-ō-dono, watashi wa seirei no michibiki de koko ni kimashita…
literal: King Felishika, I came here led by the spirit; I don't know what this demon is; but if none but I can defeat him, I will stake my life on the mission
en: King Felishika, the Spirit's guidance brought me here. What manner of fiend this is, or what power he holds, I cannot say. But if no one else can defeat him, I will stake my life upon this quest.
dos_en: Your Majesty, I have followed the light of the Spirit to this place. I know not of this demon...

en: Ah! Then I place my trust in you!
dos_en: For the first time since the sandstorm began, you have brought hope into my heart...

ja: フッフッフッフッハッハッハッハッ
en: Heh heh heh... Hah hah hah hah!

ja: お前ごとき若造が俺を倒すとは片腹痛いわ。
reading: omae gotoki wakazō ga ore o taosu to wa katahara itai wa.
literal: a whelp like you defeating me? laughable
en: A whelp like you, defeat me? Don't make me laugh!
dos_en: Are you the fool who dares to challenge me? Don't be absurd!
note: Archfiend (uses 俺 here, わし later).

dos_en: And you must be the evil Jashiin!

ja: 魔王様と呼べ、魔王様と。…
literal: call me Lord Demon King; I could kill you now, but I'm rather bored; try not to bore me; you can never defeat me anyway
en: That's LORD Archfiend to you! I could crush you here and now, but I find myself with time on my hands. Do try to keep me entertained. Not that anything you do could ever bring me down.
dos_en: You shall address me as the Emperor of Chaos... THE EMPEROR OF CHAOS! Young fool, I could destroy you now, but I need a little amusement...

literal: don't joke! I will take back the nine crystals and seal you in the earth again; wait for me
en: Enough! I will win back all nine crystals and seal you under the earth once more. Wait for me!
dos_en: Mark my words, evil one: I will not stop until I have reclaimed the nine holy crystals, and sealed you under the earth once and for all!

ja: フフフッ、わしが造りあげた迷宮は深く広い、道に迷って泣くがよい。…
reading: fufuffu, washi ga tsukuriageta meikyū wa fukaku hiroi, michi ni mayotte naku ga yoi…
literal: my labyrinth is deep and wide; get lost and weep; I'll tell my minions; they'll be glad to eat human flesh again
en: Heh heh... My labyrinth is deep and wide. Lose your way and weep! I shall let my servants know you're coming. No one has entered in so long, they'll be delighted to taste human flesh again.
dos_en: My labyrinths are immense, and run deep into the earth... They are hungry for human flesh.

ja: ゆくぞ、待っているがいい魔王。…
reading: yuku zo, matte iru ga ii maō…
literal: let's go; wait for me, demon king; I'll defeat you and your minions and restore this land
en: Then I go! Wait for me, Archfiend. I'll cut down you and all your servants, and make this land beautiful again.
dos_en: You haven't seen the last of me, Jashiin! Your reign of evil is near its end!

ja: おお、勇者デューク・ガーランドよ / 旅の途中、お金が必要になることもあるだろう / そなたに、1000ゴールドを与えよう
reading: ō, yūsha Dyūku Gārando yo / tabi no tochū, okane ga hitsuyō ni naru koto mo aru darō / sonata ni, sen gōrudo o ataeyō
literal: oh hero Duke Garland; you may need money on your journey; I give you 1000 gold
en: Ah, brave Duke Garland! You will have need of coin upon your journey. Take these 1000 gold. Defeat the Archfiend with all haste, and restore my Felisa to me!
dos_en: Brave Duke Garland, you'll need money for your journey. I hereby bestow upon you 1000 Golds.
note: King, first visit. Last sentence (not quoted) asks him to hurry and restore Felisa.

ja: おお、勇者デュークよ、忘れ物か？
reading: ō, yūsha Dyūku yo, wasuremono ka?
literal: oh hero Duke, forget something? the cave entrance is at the edge of Muralla
en: Brave Duke, have you forgotten something? The cavern mouth lies at the edge of Muralla.
dos_en: Brave Duke, did you forget something? The entrance to the labyrinth is at the edge of town.

ja: 今まで何人もの若者が洞窟に入っていったが帰ったものはほとんどいない…。
reading: ima made nannin mo no wakamono ga dōkutsu ni haitte itta ga kaetta mono wa hotondo inai…
literal: many young men entered the caves but almost none returned
en: Many a young man has gone into those caverns. Hardly any came back...

ja: 伝え聞くところでは、地下にはまだ、魔王の力のとどかぬ所が残っていて…
reading: tsutaekiku tokoro de wa, chika ni wa mada, maō no chikara no todokanu tokoro ga nokotte ite…
literal: rumor says places beyond the demon's reach remain underground, where a few people live; they would surely help
en: They say there are still places below the Archfiend's reach, where a few folk yet live. They would surely lend you aid.

ja: おお…。いとしのフェリーサ姫よ…なぜ、石にされてしまったんだ…。
reading: ō… itoshi no Ferīsa-hime yo… naze, ishi ni sarete shimatta n da…
literal: oh... beloved Princess Felisa... why were you turned to stone...
en: Oh... my sweet Princess Felisa... why did they turn you to stone...?

ja: 勇者よ / 疲れたときは必ずこの教会にくるのだぞ / 汝に神と精霊の御加護があらんことを…
reading: yūsha yo / tsukareta toki wa kanarazu kono kyōkai ni kuru no da zo / nanji ni kami to seirei no gokago ga aran koto o…
literal: hero; when tired, be sure to come to this church; may god and the spirit protect you
en: Brave one, whenever you are weary, come to this church. May God and the Spirit watch over you...
dos_en: Brave Knight, whenever you're tired come to this church... May God go with you.
note: Priest, Muralla. DOS drops 'and the Spirit'.

ja: このさびれた教会でよければ休んでゆくがよいぞ
reading: kono sabireta kyōkai de yokereba yasunde yuku ga yoi zo
literal: if this run-down church will do, rest here
en: You look worn from battle, brave one. If this poor, forsaken church will serve, rest here awhile.

ja: 冷やかしなら出て行け！！
literal: if you're just window-shopping, get out!!
en: If you're just lookin', get out!!

ja: 修行の剣ですかい / 400 ゴールドで取り引きですぜ
reading: shugyō no ken desu kai / yonhyaku gōrudo de torihiki desu ze
literal: the Training Sword, eh? that's 400 gold; I'll take your old weapon in trade for N gold; all right?
en: The Training Sword, eh? That'll be 400 gold. I'll take your old blade in trade for [N] gold. Deal?
dos_en: I'll give you &golds on your old weapon as a trade-in.
note: Smith speaks rough Edo-style (～ですかい, ～ですぜ, ダンナ). Screenshot text.

ja: その武器は売れないな　うちにも一本しか無いんだ　他の武器にしてくれ
reading: sono buki wa urenai na / uchi ni mo ippon shika nai n da / hoka no buki ni shite kure
literal: can't sell that weapon; I only have one; pick another
en: Can't sell you that one. It's the only one I've got. Pick something else.

ja: ダンナ！！！ / もしかしてそれは栄光の紋章じゃないですか
reading: danna!!! / moshika shite sore wa eikō no monshō ja nai desu ka
literal: boss!!! could that be the Crest of Glory? ... would you trade it for the Hero's Sword?
en: Sir!!! Could that be... the Crest of Glory? If you'd part with it... no, not for nothing, mind you. Would you take the Hero's Sword for it?
dos_en: Well I'll be... Isn't that the crest of honor you bear? ... Might I trade you a knight's sword for it?

ja: 当銀行の換金レートは１アルマスにつき、２ゴールドだが、よろしいかな
reading: tō-ginkō no kankin rēto wa ichi arumasu ni tsuki, ni gōrudo da ga, yoroshii ka na
literal: this bank's exchange rate is 2 gold per 1 alma; is that acceptable?
en: Our rate of exchange is 2 gold for every alma. Is that agreeable?
dos_en: Our exchange rate is & almas to & golds. Will that be all right?
note: From low-res 1987-12 advert screenshot; reading uncertain.

ja: 今度は巨額の貯金を待っておるぞ
reading: kondo wa kyogaku no chokin o matte oru zo
literal: next time I'll await a huge deposit
en: Next time, I'll expect a princely deposit!

ja: 我は賢者なり / 汝のこれからの旅の手助けをして差し上げよう
reading: ware wa kenja nari / nanji no kore kara no tabi no tedasuke o shite sashiageyō
literal: I am a sage; I shall help you on your coming journey
en: I am a sage. I shall aid you on the road ahead.
dos_en: I am the Sage Marid. You are very brave to embark on such a dangerous journey. I shall assist you in your travels.
note: From low-res advert screenshot; reading uncertain.

ja: 汝に＿を教えてしんぜよう
dos_en: I will teach you the Magic Spell of ＿.

ja: 汝の経験は足らんようじゃ、がんばりなされ
reading: nanji no keiken wa taran yō ja, ganbarinasare
literal: your experience seems insufficient; keep at it
en: Thy experience falls short. Strive on.

ja: 汝、もう少し経験を積みなされ
reading: nanji, mō sukoshi keiken o tsuminasare

ja: 汝の背後に精霊の光が淡く見える　もう少しじゃ、がんばりなされ
reading: nanji no haigo ni seirei no hikari ga awaku mieru / mō sukoshi ja, ganbarinasare
literal: I faintly see the spirit's light behind you; almost; keep at it
en: I see the Spirit's light glimmering faintly behind thee. Thou art close. Strive on.

ja: おおっ、精霊の力がそなたに宿りおった！！
reading: ōtt, seirei no chikara ga sonata ni yadoriotta!!
literal: oh! the spirit's power has come to dwell in you!!
en: The Spirit's power overflows behind thee... Behold! It has entered into thee!!
note: Level up. Preceded by 汝の背後には精霊のちからがみなぎっておる….

ja: 汝の背後には精霊の力はもう感じられない　何度やっても同じことじゃ…
reading: nanji no haigo ni wa seirei no chikara wa mō kanjirarenai / nando yatte mo onaji koto ja…
literal: I no longer sense the spirit's power behind you; it's the same however many times
en: I sense no more of the Spirit's power in thee. Ask as often as thou wilt; the answer is the same...

ja: 精霊の導きのままに、次の世界へ行きなさい
reading: seirei no michibiki no mama ni, tsugi no sekai e ikinasai
literal: as the spirit guides, go on to the next world
en: I can grant thee no more of the Spirit's power. Go on to the next world, as the Spirit guides thee.
note: Excerpt (preceded by 我にはもう汝に精霊の力を宿らせることはできない…).

ja: ようやく目覚めたかな…　汝が倒れたとき、精霊が運んでくれたのじゃ
reading: yōyaku mezameta ka na… nanji ga taoreta toki, seirei ga hakonde kureta no ja
literal: so you've finally woken; when you fell, the spirit carried you here
en: So, thou art awake at last... When thou didst fall, the Spirit bore thee here. Take no foolish risks in battle. Now go! The Spirit watches over thee always.

ja: 地下の町「サトノ」に、我の師匠であられる、賢者ビュエナがいる
reading: chika no machi 'Satono' ni, ware no shishō de arareru, kenja Byuena ga iru
literal: in the underground town Satono is my master, the sage Buena
en: In Satono, the town beneath the earth, dwells my master, the sage Buena. He will lend thee his power.

ja: 町を出たら、左の高台に登るがよい　扉が見えるはずじゃ
reading: machi o detara, hidari no takadai ni noboru ga yoi / tobira ga mieru hazu ja
literal: leave town and climb the heights to the left; you'll see a door (the exit); but you must go round the world the other way
en: Leave the town and climb the heights to the left; thou shalt see a door. That is this world's exit, but to reach it thou must circle the world the other way.

ja: この世界の出口はこの村を出たすぐ近くにある
reading: kono sekai no deguchi wa kono mura o deta sugu chikaku ni aru
literal: this world's exit is near the village; first get the Hero's Crest and fight a magically enlarged bird
en: This world's exit lies just outside the village. But first thou must find the Hero's Crest, and face a dreadful bird grown giant by sorcery...

ja: 低い道を行くときはかがみなさい　氷の針を進むよりは別の道をえらびなさい
reading: hikui michi o yuku toki wa kagaminasai / kōri no hari o susumu yori wa betsu no michi o erabinasai
literal: crouch on low paths; choose another road rather than walk the ice needles
en: A message from the Spirit: crouch where the way is low, and choose another path rather than cross the icy spikes. Heed these words.

ja: 腐土の果てに巣食う魔物は勇者の剣がなければ倒すことはできぬ
reading: fudo no hate ni sukuu mamono wa yūsha no ken ga nakereba taosu koto wa dekinu
literal: the monster nesting at the end of the rotten earth can't be beaten without the Hero's Sword
en: The beast that lairs at the blighted world's end cannot be slain without the Hero's Sword. Open not its door until that sword is thine.

ja: この世界を出たければ精霊がパーセルに作らせたシルカーノの靴を手に入れなさい。
reading: kono sekai o detakereba seirei ga Pāseru ni tsukuraseta Shirukāno no kutsu o te ni irenasai.
literal: to leave this world, obtain the Silkarn Shoes the spirit had Percel make
en: If thou wouldst leave this world, find the Silkarn Shoes the Spirit bade Percel make. Without them thou shalt never escape it.
note: Sage Jufe. Source typo なけれれば not quoted.

ja: この世界はドラゴンが支配している
reading: kono sekai wa doragon ga shihai shite iru
literal: a dragon rules this world; you must open three closed doors to reach it
en: A dragon rules this world. To reach it, thou must open three sealed doors.

ja: この世界の果てには最後の敵、魔王がいる…
reading: kono sekai no hate ni wa saigo no teki, maō ga iru…
literal: at this world's end is the last enemy, the demon king; take the Witchfire Sword; first you must defeat the undying beast Alguien
en: At the end of this world waits thy final foe, the Archfiend. Carry the Witchfire Sword if thou wouldst face him. But first thou must slay Alguien, the deathless beast.

reading: watashi, kinō yume o mita no…
literal: I had a dream: a scary man made 8 caves with monsters; a big brother brought by the spirit beat them
en: I had a dream last night! A scary man made eight caves and put monsters in them. But a big brother the Spirit brought here beat them all!

ja: わしの息子ミハエルは勇敢な戦士じゃった。…
reading: washi no musuko Mihaeru wa yūkan na senshi jatta…
literal: my son Michael was a brave warrior, but went into the caves and never returned
en: My son Michael was a brave warrior. He went into the caverns and never came back... Take care, young sir.

ja: 怪物を倒すとアルマスという物が手に入る。…
reading: kaibutsu o taosu to arumasu to iu mono ga te ni hairu…
literal: kill monsters and you get almas; worth good money; I want some but won't go down there
en: Kill a monster and you get these things called almas. Fetch a good price, they say. I'd like some myself, but you won't catch me going down there.

ja: うぃー……。どうせ死ぬんだ。…
literal: hic... we'll all die anyway; don't go somewhere scary, drink with me
en: Hic... We're all gonna die anyway. You, me, the whole town. Why go somewhere scary? Have a drink with me.

ja: 精霊の守護力を補うために、アルマスの壁をきずくことが必要なのだ。…
reading: seirei no shugoryoku o oginau tame ni, arumasu no kabe o kizuku koto ga hitsuyō na no da…
literal: to supplement the spirit's protection we need a wall of almas
en: We must raise a wall of almas to bolster the Spirit's protection. Without more almas, even Satono is in danger.

ja: アルマスは魔王のエネルギーの一部なんだけど、…
reading: arumasu wa maō no enerugī no ichibu na n da kedo…
literal: almas are part of the demon king's energy, but processed they become medicine, barriers, etc.
en: Almas are a piece of the Archfiend's own power. But worked properly, they become medicines, barriers, all sorts of useful things.
note: Satono woman. Excerpt. Core lore: 'almas' (Sp. souls).

ja: 行き止まりになったらそこを掘ってみな。
reading: ikidomari ni nattara soko o hotte mi na.
literal: when you hit a dead end, try digging there
en: Hit a dead end? Try digging. The Archfiend's hidden treasure all over the place.

ja: タコだ、恐ろしく大きいタコの化物だ。
reading: tako da, osoroshiku ōkii tako no bakemono da.
literal: an octopus, a terribly huge octopus monster
en: An octopus! A monstrous, gigantic octopus! It glared at me, waving those long arms...

ja: ちょっと待てっ！！おまえは勇者の紋章を持っているか。
reading: chotto mate!! omae wa yūsha no monshō o motte iru ka.
literal: wait!! do you have the Hero's Crest?
en: Halt!! Do you carry the Hero's Crest?

ja: ちょっと待てっ！！おまえは勇者の紋章を持っているようだな。よし、通れ！！
reading: chotto mate!! omae wa yūsha no monshō o motte iru yō da na. yoshi, tōre!!
literal: wait!! you seem to have the Hero's Crest; good, pass!!
en: Halt!! ...Ah, you bear the Hero's Crest. Very well, pass!!

ja: 神殿には武勇神の紋章が刻まれていた。…
reading: shinden ni wa buyūshin no monshō ga kizamarete ita…
literal: the temple bore the crest of the god of valor; tourney winners received it; the Hero's Crest, symbol of justice
en: The temple bore the crest of the god of valor. The champion of each tourney held before it received that same crest, a symbol of justice called the Hero's Crest.

ja: 危険！！！　この先の箱　開けるべからず
reading: kiken!!! kono saki no hako akeru bekarazu
literal: danger!!! do not open the box ahead
en: DANGER!!! Do not open the chest ahead.

ja: この木　一番太い木なり
reading: kono ki ichiban futoi ki nari
literal: this tree is the thickest tree

ja: よくぞ、ここまで来られた。さぞ、さむかったであろう。…
reading: yokuzo, koko made korareta. sazo, samukatta de arō…
literal: well done coming here; you must be cold; Helada was warm and rich until the demon king froze it
en: You've come far, and you must be frozen. Helada was once a warm and bountiful land, until the Archfiend made it a cold, ruined town.

ja: パーセルを返してよ。あなたさえいなかったら…。
reading: Pāseru o kaeshite yo. anata sae inakattara…
literal: give me back Percel; if only you didn't exist
en: My Percel was killed only because the Spirit made him craft shoes for you! Give him back! If it weren't for you...

ja: 緑のスライムには悩まされたであろう。…
reading: midori no suraimu ni wa nayamasareta de arō…
literal: green slimes troubled you; they're weak to heat; roast them and they evaporate
en: Those green slimes gave you trouble, eh? They can't abide heat. Singe 'em with fire and they boil away in one go.

ja: 勇者よ、あわれなこの町を救ってくだされ。…
reading: yūsha yo, aware na kono machi o sukutte kudasare…
literal: hero, save this wretched town; once a quiet graveyard, made rotten by the demon king
en: Brave one, save our wretched town! This was a quiet burial ground once, before the Archfiend turned it to rotting earth.

ja: これは、秘密の話なんだが…。おれはもと魔王のスパイだったんだ…。
reading: kore wa, himitsu no hanashi na n da ga… ore wa moto maō no supai datta n da…
literal: this is a secret: I used to be the demon king's spy; I threw the Pirika Shoes in a box somewhere in the rot
en: Keep this quiet... I used to spy for the Archfiend. I stuffed the Pirika Shoes in a box and dumped it somewhere in the rot. Sorry.

ja: 奴らを成仏させるんだったら頭をねらえ。
reading: yatsura o jōbutsu saseru n dattara atama o nerae.
literal: if you want to lay them to rest, aim for the head
en: Seen the pale men? Gelroid got 'em and they can't die proper. If you want to put 'em to rest, go for the head.

ja: 魔王が復活したのは人々の心が平和に酔いしれて、堕落してしまったためだと精霊は言っていたわ。
reading: maō ga fukkatsu shita no wa hitobito no kokoro ga heiwa ni yoishirete, daraku shite shimatta tame da to seirei wa itte ita wa.
literal: the spirit said the demon king revived because people's hearts grew drunk on peace and fell into decadence
en: The Spirit said the Archfiend returned because people grew drunk on peace and fell into decadence.
dos_en: The Spirits say that Jashiin returned because the people, made soft by peace and prosperity, sank into corruption.
note: Dorado woman; also an in-game screenshot on the rip site.

ja: あのね、迷宮の中は純金で造られてるんだって！
reading: ano ne, meikyū no naka wa junkin de tsukurareteru n datte!
literal: the labyrinth is made of pure gold; some walls are fake gold and can be broken
en: Guess what! The maze is made of pure gold! But some walls are fake gold, and you can break those!

ja: この町にはタルソと言われる平和の像があったんだが、一晩で姿を消してしまった。
reading: kono machi ni wa Taruso to iwareru heiwa no zō ga atta n da ga, hitoban de sugata o keshite shimatta.
literal: this town had a peace statue called Tarso, but it vanished overnight
en: This town had a statue of peace called Tarso, but it vanished in a single night. Where could it have gone?
note: Dorado man; Tarso is a boss.

ja: お前は、エルフの紋章を持ってないな。…
reading: omae wa, erufu no monshō o mottenai na…
literal: you don't have the Elf Crest; lately the demon's agents pose as heroes; are you one of them?
en: You've no Elf Crest. Of late the Archfiend's agents have been calling themselves heroes and ravaging this town. Are you one of them?
dos_en: You cannot pass here without the Hero's Crest...
note: Llama elder. Excerpt. DOS reworks the crest requirement.

ja: おれの名はミハエルって言うんだけど、…
reading: ore no na wa Mihaeru tte iu n da kedo…
literal: my name's Michael; nobody here will talk to me; I can't go fight the demon king like this
en: Name's Michael. I made it all the way here and now nobody'll talk to me. How am I supposed to beat the Archfiend like this?
note: Excerpt. On seeing the crest: あっ、エルフの紋章を持っている！！　いいな、いいな。

ja: 防熱の効果がある、アブソルのマントだ。
reading: bōnetsu no kōka ga aru, Abusoru no manto da.
literal: it's the Absor Cloak, which protects from heat; I'll part with it for 5000 almas
en: Hot in them caves, eh? I've got just the thing: an Absor Cloak, proof against heat. Won't come free, mind. 5000 almas and it's yours.
note: Llama man. Excerpt. DOS price is 2500.

ja: お前の助けようとしている姫はお前の輪廻の目印だ。…
reading: omae no tasukeyō to shite iru hime wa omae no rinne no mejirushi da…
literal: the princess you want to save is the marker of your reincarnation; the spirit is a demon incarnate; because you are the demon king
en: The princess you would save is the signpost of your own rebirth. The Spirit is a devil in disguise. For YOU are the Archfiend! Wahahaha...
dos_en: YOU! The princess you struggle to rescue will lead you to your doom! The Spirits are just demons in disguise...
note: Pureza man under the demon's sway. Excerpt. JP twist ('you are the demon king') is softened in DOS.

ja: 魔王を倒すことが出来る唯一の武器は、妖炎の剣だ。…
reading: maō o taosu koto ga dekiru yuiitsu no buki wa, yōen no ken da…
literal: the only weapon that can kill the demon king is the Witchfire Sword; it glows eerily and kills in one blow
en: Only the Witchfire Sword can slay the Archfiend. The legends say it shines with an eerie light and fells any foe in a single stroke. But where it lies...

ja: 私は精霊から、獅子の頭の形をした鍵を預かったのですが、…
reading: watashi wa seirei kara, shishi no atama no katachi o shita kagi o azukatta no desu ga…
literal: the spirit entrusted me with a lion-head key, but the demon's minions stole it
en: The Spirit entrusted me with a key shaped like a lion's head, but the Archfiend's servants stole it. Forgive me. Please, find it.

ja: 汝は、この世界に疑問を持たれぬか。…
reading: nanji wa, kono sekai ni gimon o motarenu ka…
literal: do you not question this world? why did the spirit send you on this journey of slaughter? why does the demon king wait silently for you?
en: Dost thou never question this world? Why did the Spirit send thee on this road of slaughter? Why does the Archfiend sit and wait for thee in silence?
dos_en: Why have the Spirits sent you on this journey of slaughter? Why does Jashiin await you in silence?

ja: あの二人の言うことは気にしない方がいいですわ。…
reading: ano futari no iu koto wa ki ni shinai hō ga ii desu wa…
literal: don't mind what those two say; they're the demon king's agents trying to sap your will
en: Pay those two no mind. They serve the Archfiend, and only want to steal your will to fight.

ja: 手加減はせん！ どこからでも来い！！
reading: tekagen wa sen! doko kara demo koi!!
literal: I won't hold back! come at me from anywhere!!
en: I'll show no mercy! Come at me however you like!!

ja: あなたの修行は始まったばかり。立ち止まることは許されません
reading: anata no shugyō wa hajimatta bakari. tachidomaru koto wa yurusaremasen
literal: your training has only just begun; you are not permitted to stop
en: Your trial has only begun. You may not stand still.
dos_en: You have suffered many hardships to defeat Jashiin, Duke Garland... There was no time to rest...
note: LOW CONFIDENCE: quoted from memory by a blog commenter, not a transcription. The rip site paraphrases it as 立ち止まるな、前へ進め！. No verified Japanese ending script was found.

literal: scheduled for release in early December
note: 1987-11 advert: PC-8801mkII SR series, PC-88VA compatible, 5" 2D x2 disks, 2 drives required. Actual release 1987-12-19, 7,500 yen.

ja: 究極のアニメーション
note: Blurb heading. Body (summarized): each monster has its own routine, e.g. slimes that split when struck carelessly, vampire bats that swoop from the ceiling, and croaking toads.

ja: 華麗な巨大キャラクタ
note: Body (summarized): giants such as the Gelatinous Cube (ゼラチノスキューブ) and the Dragon are drawn at the SR's size limit.

ja: 雰囲気を演出する音声合成とBGM
reading: fun'iki o enshutsu suru onsei gōsei to BGM
literal: speech synthesis and BGM that create atmosphere
note: Body (summarized): the shop girl's voice and the sage's prayer use speech synthesis.

ja: 快適な操作性と絶妙のプレイバランス
reading: kaiteki na sōsasei to zetsumyō no purei baransu
literal: comfortable controls and exquisite play balance

note: New-moon night two months after the curse; the dark festival (暗黒祭) at which Felisa is to be sacrificed. Opening uses 神々の沈む夜.
Currency dropped by monsters; a fragment of the Archfiend's energy.
Metal of the Shield of Light.
